Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: CIPC (Companies and Intellectual Property Commission) offers fully digital company registration. SARS digital integration with registered businesses is well-established. e-Procurement portal (eTender) operational. CIPC-SARS data sharing for tax compliance is documented. Government plans single business registration window via digital transformation roadmap.

Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: DHA manages civil registration (births, deaths, marriages) via integrated biometric Smart ID system. IDEMIA biometric enrollment links CRVS to digital ID. DHA-SARS data sharing agreement (formalised April 2025 multiparty deal) enables cross-verification of civil registration records. Birth registration is linked to the national ID system.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Smart ID expansion underway with 3.6 million target for 2025 (IDEMIA 10-year contract for 80M smart cards). SARS-DHA-BMA-GPW multiparty digital ID deal signed April 2025 enabling cross-agency biometric verification. UDI (Unique Digital Identifier) planned to link all government services. Green ID book being phased out. DHA 'Home Affairs @ Home' digital delivery initiative.

Comments: IEC (Electoral Commission of South Africa) has digital voter registration, online VoterPortal, and Results Dashboard. Comments: DHA manages passports and Smart IDs via integrated biometric system. SARS-DHA-BMA-GPW multiparty deal (April 2025) explicitly includes Border Management Authority for passport and immigration data sharing. E-passport system operational. Biometric border control at major ports of entry.

Comments: SASSA serves 18+ million grant recipients via MasterCard-linked payment system. SARB PayShap instant payment system operational. Comments: Stats SA (Statistics South Africa) has digital data systems integrated with Treasury and planning functions. Comments: SARS is a highly digitalised revenue authority with API connections to DHA, BMA, and GPW formalised in April 2025 multiparty deal. SARS eFiling platform widely used. SARS-DHA data sharing operational since ~2010 for identity verification. SARS uses AI analytics for tax compliance risk profiling.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: SASSA serves approximately 50% of South Africans (~28M grant recipients across all programs). SASSA MasterCard payment integration operational. SRD R370 system operational. End-to-end G2P digital payment system under Initiative 3 of the Roadmap targeting Q4 2026. SPDCI (2025) documents integration of social assistance with labor market systems underway.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act) effective July 1 2021 with Information Regulator enforcement powers. SITA Act (Act 88 of 1998) mandates Minimum Interoperability Standards (MIOS v6.0) for all government ICT. Public Service Act and Regulations require MIOS compliance. These collectively enable and govern cross-government data sharing.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: Cabinet-endorsed Roadmap for Digital Transformation of Government (2025) includes four initiatives with specific milestones: Initiative 2 (Data Exchange) targets Q4 2026 and Q4 2027 deliverables. IDWG established September 2024 to drive implementation. MyMzansi.gov.za provides public roadmap transparency.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Multiple comprehensive strategies exist: (1) Roadmap for the Digital Transformation of Government (Cabinet-endorsed ~March 2025), with Initiative 2 dedicated to Data Exchange; (2) National Citizen-Centric Digital Government Strategy 2025-2030 (GITOC); (3) National e-Government Strategy and Roadmap. Digital Service Unit (DSU) being established in The Presidency to coordinate implementation.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Smart ID delivered via banking branches expanding reach. 'Home Affairs @ Home' vision for document delivery without in-person visits. Home delivery option for ID documents being piloted. Government websites must comply with WCAG accessibility standards under SITA guidelines. Digital divide challenges acknowledged in roadmap. Disability access provisions exist but implementation is uneven.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: POPIA (effective July 2021) enforced by independent Information Regulator with fines up to ZAR 10 million or 10% of annual turnover. Financial sector data localization requirements under FSCA. Government Private Cloud being built under SITA Data Centre Framework. Cloud Policy for Government (2021) mandates data sovereignty assessment before cloud adoption. Strong legal framework with active enforcement.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: 9 provinces have their own government IT systems with MIOS (Minimum Interoperability Standards v6.0) mandatory for all national and provincial departments. Local government MIOS compliance is informative only per SITA policy. SAConnect Phase 2 targets 42000+ sites including local government. Some cybersecurity failures at municipal level documented. Partial but not full sub-national participation.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Significant urban-rural digital divide persists. SAConnect Phase 2 targeting rural schools and health facilities for connectivity. Load shedding (power outages) disproportionately affects rural and peri-urban connectivity. Development Gateway notes urban-rural gap in South Africa. SA ranked ~85th on 2024 UN EGDI overall but rural access lags significantly behind urban areas. Services remain primarily urban-accessible.
